reconstructed_theorem_text: For every normed real inner-product space E carrying a measurable structure, every real kappa, and arbitrary measures mu and nu on E times E, phaseWassersteinSq kappa mu nu is exactly Transport.transportCost of phaseCost kappa between mu and nu. Its value is extended nonnegative real. No probability, equal-mass, finite-moment, finite-cost, optimizer, Borel, or kappa>=1 assumption is part of the definition.
objects: A phase point cost, two measures, and their Kantorovich transportCost.
domains: Arbitrary measures and every real kappa, with an ENNReal value.
quantifiers: Every measurable phase space, kappa, mu and nu.
assumptions: Only a measurable structure is needed to state the raw transport infimum.
conclusion: The raw Kantorovich value for the exact phaseCost.
scopes: No optimizer, symmetry, triangle inequality, finiteness, or dynamics.
constant_dependencies: All kappa dependence is in phaseCost; no extra factor is introduced.
